items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: I worked at them a while with a, with Zev and different guys like that.

ctx.x: What about Coyne? What were you doing in those days when the jittery lad was going, like in the Coyne?
Well, I worked, I worked on Canal Street a while, um, Madden Gabriel. I worked at them a while with a, with Zev and different guys like that. Did you have a day job too?
